title: The Breath in the Teenager's Room

sentences.text: Hush... a fragile shift began in the teenager's room at 01:10, where the usual atmosphere started to tremble.
I sensed the air thickening, as the humidity rose above the expected range of 42.2 % to 44.6 %.
At the peak, 02:00, the sensors felt a distinct cold breath on the glass, registering at 46.6 % humidity.
The chilling presence drifted down from above, an unseen visitor passing through the glass.
It lingered, this sweet, strange presence, before finally receding by 03:10.
